turn: The background sync scheduler step is finished. The last commit adds a test in src/scheduler/run.test.ts. It checks that canSyncPhotos returns false when the network is cellular, even with a full battery and the device not charging. That confirms photo uploads are held back on cellular data. I wrote the test against the existing canSyncPhotos condition in conditions.js. I haven't run the suite in this message, so I can't report a pass result. In the same commit I also fixed a small unrelated problem I noticed: the scheduler's test file imported from './conditions' without the .js extension in one place, which would break under ESM resolution, so I made it match the other imports. Next I'll start on "Last-write-wins conflict resolution".

sidefix.title: Fix missing .js import extension
sidefix.what: Added the missing .js extension to a relative import in the scheduler code so it resolves under ESM like the other imports.
